headline: A regular quarterly dividend: Nexstar declares its usual $1.86 a share
reasoning: Source: Nexstar's 8-K filed 12:22 ET, item 8.01: 'its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $1.86 per share on its outstanding common stock ... payable on November 27, 2026'.
What changed: nothing. The filing does not call it an increase, a cut or a special. IEX shows no trades since the filing.
